new_nodes.label: En Soph (the Simple and the One)

reference.quote: Adam stands not only for the psyche but for its totality; he is a symbol of the self
Adam would then be a quaternarius, as he was composed of red, black, white, and green dust from the four corners of the earth
Adam, being composed of the four elements, either is the prima materia and the arcane substance itself
Since Adam signifies not only the beginning of the work, the prima materia, but also the end, the lapis
The figure of Adam readily lent itself as a biblical synonym for the alchemical Mercurius
As the first man, Adam is the homo maximus , the Anthropos, from whom the macrocosm arose, or who is the macrocosm
For Adam is “interior homo noster,” the Primordial Man in us.
An old tradition says that Adam was created “a lifeless statue.”
The second Adam is Christ, whose mystical androgyny is established in ecclesiastical tradition.
Here the statue evidently denotes the end-product of the process, the lapis Philosophorum or its equivalent.
It is clear from these extracts that the statue or pillar is either the perfect Primordial Man
the Haye Sarah on Genesis 28:22 says that Malchuth is called the “statue” when she is united with Tifereth

candidate_edges.subject: anthropos
candidate_edges.source: Knorr von Rosenroth, Tractatus de Revolutionibus Animarum

reference.quote: From En Soph, from the most general One, was produced the universe, which is Adam Kadmon, who is One and Many
Accordingly, Adam Kadmon here takes the place of Tifereth.
Adam Kadmon is not merely the universal soul ... but is himself the process of transformation, its division into three or four parts (trimeria or tetrameria)
The alchemists could not help identifying their Primordial Man with Christ
The “old Adam” corresponds to the primitive man, the “shadow” of our present-day consciousness
The reader is immediately struck by the expression “the old Adam,” who is evidently equated with Adam Kadmon.
The black Shulamite in our text corresponds to Malchuth as a widow, who awaits union with Tifereth and hence the restoration of the original wholeness.
the speaker is the feminine personification of the prima materia in the nigredo state ... Psychologically this dark figure is the unconscious anima.
